title: Piece spotlight: the Knight has three different execution routines and the game picks one at random - pixel art tactics chess where every capture is an animated duel
text:
Pixel Pawns is battle-forged pixel art chess on the Microsoft Store: every capture is fought out on the board as a hand-animated duel instead of the piece just quietly vanishing.

The Knight is the showiest attacker in the set. It can run you through with a couched lance at full gallop, ride you down and trample you under the horse, or take your head off with a sabre cut from the saddle - and the game rolls which one you get, so the same capture rarely looks the same twice.

Play it against the AI across four difficulty levels (Squire, Knight, Captain, Warlord) or hot-seat against a friend.

https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PP9G5CQKKZX
